label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y todo el reptil el reptante sobre la tierra, abominación él; no será comido.
spanish: Y todo lo que pulula el reptante sobre la tierra, abominación él; no será comido.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'reptil' with 'lo que pulula' for H8318 שֶׁרֶץ (sourceTokenId h03011041002): same licensed sense (a being that swarms/crawls) cited by the auditor, not the zoological class Reptilia named by 'reptil'. Matches the resolution already applied to the same lemma in Levítico 11:20 and 11:31.
